6391.title: App shell leaves font smoothing implicit
6391.rootCauseOneLine: Two trusted builds omit shell-level font smoothing while embedded surfaces select it; macOS visual causation remains unverified.
6391.proposedFix: Verify a controlled native macOS before/after rendering comparison before centralizing a shell-level smoothing preference.
6391.caveats: Second clean run verified artifact evidence only. Linux host lacks macOS/Retina hardware and Chrome. No screenshot or failing behavioral regression test was available; no production fix was attempted. Diagnostic and exact output are inline in the report.
